reviews.review: It's worked amazingly! The shared grocery list has been a godsend and the shared calendar is so easy
Good app for reminders among the family. Doesn't adjust for time zone changes however.

Love this app. So many free features. Hubby and I both have it installed, all our appointments and other commitments are recorded, so we can all see. Reminders are easy to set up for changes to school or OOSH collection. Love the list feature - easy way to add shopping lists, so either one of us can access on adhoc shopping trips.

I've been using this app for 7 years and I still love it. It's easy to use on desktop and mobile, and with teenagers, they can now add their appointments too. This is a must have app for any family. Edit: 10 years and going strong, the kids add their own appointments now, and I love the to do list too.
Been the best calendar to date.
Nice way to share calendar activity with family.

Long time paid user. They have progressively made the tool worse as years gone by. Not only have they eliminated functions, but the lastest change is virtually unusable. Currently testing other calendars.
reviews.reply: Hi Elizabeth, We apologize for any frustration! We're actively working on updates to improve the website, and we also plan to add new features going forward. We hope you'll submit your feedback and requests via the feedback survey (from the home screen of your acct on the web), and we hope the changes we make will be useful for you! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Using this app to help balance life activities as my sister has been helping me to take care of my husband following his stroke. It's great to have a central place to see who is where doing what, who needs who to do what, and what's already been done. Live grocery lists, errand lists, chore lists, doctor appointments. I've got no complaints!!

Use to love this app but it's continuing to go down hill. The text notifications were huge for our family, push notifications are NOT a good replacement. Also, on the app we now cannot open scheduled events to see details, and multiple day events only are showing on the first day. We've tried deleting and re-adding and also clearing cache but no such luck. I think its time we strongly consider finding a replacement for our family as this is just no longer functioning properly
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for the problems you're having with your Cozi app! We haven't received other reports of the issues you described, but we've forwarded your report for investigation. You could also do a hard restart of your device and make sure there's enough internal storage available on your device. For more help: support@cozi.com. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Had this App for 13 years and loooved it. Worked flawlessly.... the drag and drop (w/o long delay), updating calendars, shopping list, anything (it used to update almost immediately, now it takes 3-5 mins to refresh, not joking!), the interface on laptop is hard to read, the calendar days are now boxes & hard to read, it is a mess! I also have to log on minimum of 3X/day on my laptop (not joking) I'm now looking for another Family Calender App after all these years. Disappointing.
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for your frustration! We're actively working on improvements to the website, including a fix for the sign out issue. We've already removed the boxes from month view and increased the font size based on user feedback. We'll release more updates in the weeks and months ahead, and we hope you'll stay with Cozi! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I LOVE Cozi. Hubby and I use it to keep everything from grocery lists, to do lists, appointments and things we want to remember. I rely on the birthday section to ensure all my friends and family get wishes on their day. I could not survive without my Cozi. We have been using it for about 8 years UPDATE: As an older person with bad eyesight, I absolutely hate that Cozi has changed the look and size of it on my laptop. I can't read it. Looking for new program. So disappointed!!
reviews.reply: Hi Christina, Thanks for the feedback, and we're sorry for any issues! We increased the font size in the month view on the web last week in response to user requests, and we hope it's an improvement for you! If you haven't yet submitted a feedback survey, please do so from the home screen of your acct on the web. Thanks, Cozi (cozi.com/contact-us)

reviews.review: Like the planning area and connection to my calendar. Would like some improvements on the Shopping list area, at least be able to sort items by checked, unchecked, alphabetical order

Very useful. We print out the month every month and stick it to our pretty calendar which hangs on the fridge and this has worked perfectly for years. Everyone in the family can access the digital calendar from their phone/computer and add or check events. Only little thing is for some slower devices, this app can be a bit slow in processing. Definitely acceptable though ;) We like our Cozi calendar.

Even using the free part of the app our family is much more organized using this shared calendar for more than a year. Highly recommend! UPDATE! We recently changed to a paid membership and are thrilled with the expanded reminders and the birthday tracking abilities. Very Highly Recommend.

I have used the App and Website for years for my Menu Planning, Recipes and grocery lists. The recent Web site update is awful and Cozi is longer usable as a menu planning tool since they have removed the Drop & Drag feature away from menu planner. I have already begun to find an alternative and will uninstall as soon as I get my recipes transferred.
reviews.reply: Hi Michael, We're sorry for any disappointment! We're actively working on additional improvements to the Cozi website, so please submit your feedback via the feedback survey that's available from the home screen in your account on the web. We will continue to make updates in the weeks ahead based on user feedback! Thanks, Cozi (cozi.com/contact-us)

reviews.review: Great app to help our family stay organized with ONE calendar!
Like the ability to set multiple reminders and select family members that calendar entry actually applies too.

As a free app, the minimal amount of ads is not too intrusive. Our family benefits from having everybody able to add and delete (e.g. our grocery list). I do wish for the greater calendar function available in the paid version, but we cannot afford the annual fee. For those of you tempted by a similar Google product, remember, "if the app is free, then you are the product." I would rather "pay" these fine folks for this app by viewing an occasional ad than have creepy Google keep tabs on me.

Overall- It's a nice app to have... I like that I can share it with the whole family and it's easy to use. I also enjoy having a place to keep all my favorite recipes. I wish it had contacts, a meal planner, and allowed me to make changes to the appearance other than just color theme, though. I also wish I could sort my grocery lists either alphabetically or by category but it's just a basic list. If it got all those things I'd give 5 stars.

This app has everything I need to keep up with my daily life. I recently learned that I can use the Lists option for my grocery list. The family can add items they want/need to the list and, more importantly, no more getting to the grocery store and realizing I forgot the list at home.
We use cozi all the time and we like that both of us knows all appointments etc. Best is reminders and how far in advance you can make them. Definitely recommend!
I'm not paying to get month view in the calendar.
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for any frustration! The interactive mobile month view is part of the Gold version, but you could access another month view from the free version by tapping on the month title above the calendar screen. You could use that mini-month calendar for reference or to jump to a future date to add an appt. Thanks, Cozi (cozi.com/contact-us)

reviews.review: Best sharing calendar ever, I share this with my mum and sister so if we need to help with each other's kids we know who's got what on, it even syncs your google calendar too, you can also assign colours to each person and filter who your wanting to look at, I love it and I've used many other calendars. Adds are minimal on free version. Plus you can sign in on a decsk top, its so user friendly.
Intuitive and well done shared calendar. I was able to integrate my Google calendar, and my wife her iCal. I turned on a daily email containing the days agenda. Very useful.

Awesome for organization!!! We have a family of six all involved in multiple things. I love that I can easily input everyone's schedule and reminders are sent. The color coding makes my heart happy too! 😝
It's awesome for coordinating family schedules. We depend on it everyday. Superior to Google calendar.

Guessing it's just me, but I find the calendar somewhat confusing. I'm constantly adding events on the wrong day... for me, having the date at the bottom of the date box is odd and unlike conventional calendars. That said, my wife absolutely loves this app... so there you have it!

We love this calendar. I don't know how it compares to other ones, but the whole family has one calendar on us at all times, same for shopping and group to dos. This was the first one we tried before we had smart phones, so maybe there are better ones, but this one is great with everything we need. Oh, I do wish searching was a free feature, but not gonna complain.
Easy to use, updates to your calendar sent. Reminders sent.
Love it keep a shared calendar with wife
Love it but payed for cozi + and can't use any of the features like calendar view. Super dissapointed and don't know how to contact anyone for support.
reviews.reply: Hi Kim, Please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us so we can help to resolve any issues! The mobile month cal is designed as an overview. To access appts from that view, double-tap to go to the 2x2 zoom. Tap on an appt to open it, use the + to create a new appt or scroll vertically or horizontally to view neighboring or upcoming dates. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Very easy to use, and I was also easily able to port my Google calendar into it. Extremely convenient for my family of 5 to keep track of work, school and extra curriculars.

This app is NOT suitable for co-parenting 1- When a message is posted, is not clear who has posted it 2- After a message is posted, each party can edit/delete it with no trace or log 3- When emailing a message to the other party, you cannot choose the messages. It basically dumps the entire list into the body of your email app and you get to edit manually 4- There's no notification at all. You have to constantly check the app for new messages
reviews.reply: Hi, Lots of people use Cozi for co-parenting, but it works best for amicable, low-conflict co-parenting. We apologize if Cozi doesn't offer some of the features you need for your situation, and we've forwarded your feedback and requests. For help with resolving any notification delivery issues, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Ok, calendar month view poorly designed
reviews.reply: Hi, Sorry for your disappointment and we'll forward your feedback. The mobile month view is designed to give you a monthly overview. To access appts from the month view, double-tap to go to the 2x2 zoom. Tap on an appt to open it, use the + to create a new appt or scroll vertically or horizontally to view neighboring or upcoming dates. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Great for syncing household to do and grocery lists for multiple people and phones.
App is great except for the grocery list feature.
The shared calendar is very helpful. My husband never seemed to know what we had going on from day to day, and now he has no excuses! Lol

Our family has been using Cozi for about 2 years. It is convenient fr us to share a calendar, but I'm always looking for a better option because it is missing some features. It's not easy to read, and there is a learning curve. But it updates within seconds, so that's okay. I wish you could assign different colors to different tasks like the Google calendar. That would help me for quick glance. I don't think it's easy on the easy, I like simple, but then still give user the ability to dig down
Why aren't reminders working again?
reviews.reply: Hi Tim, To ensure that you'll receive your Cozi reminders, please check your Android settings to make sure that sleep move and battery-saving mode are turned OFF, and auto-start for Cozi is turned ON. These settings can suppress device notifications unless you're actively using the app at the time of scheduled delivery. Thanks, Cozi (help@cozi.com)

reviews.review: So far so good. One major flaw is that you can't see a month layout without paying a fee. This might actually turn me back to Google calendar. Shame.
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for any frustration! The interactive mobile month view is part of the Gold version, but you could access another month view from the free version by tapping on the month title above the calendar screen. You could use the mini-month calendar for reference or to go to a future date to add an appt. Thanks, Cozi (cozi.com/contact-us)

reviews.review: I like many of the features, however, my biggest issue is the calendar does not store any events put in unless they are Annual events that happen each (like birthdays, anniversaries). Often times I have a need to see when I may have had an appointment with a doctor or anything. This is disappointing.
reviews.reply: Hi, Cozi saves and stores all appts you add to the calendar, including unique appts and recurring appts. Cozi does not automatically delete any data, even after years, so you'll always be able to reference past events. If you're encountering any issues, please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us so we can help! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Great family calendar app
I love that my whole family can add to the calendar! And that my everyone can see what's going on! It's been so helpful not to overbook with a family of 7!!
Makes it super easy to share a calendar with my extended family.
We use this almost exclusively for compiling a grocery list over the week. My spouse and I share the list and items independently as we identify needs. When one of us shops, all our items are there.

I set everything up but I can only create calendar items for 'All' rather than individual family members which I thought was the whole point of the app. The Help option just takes me to FAQs which are unhelpful and no way to contact for support. Waste of the time.
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for any issues, and we'd be happy to help at cozi.com/contact-us. If you've created an acct and added other family members, it should be possible to select All, or individual names, or a subset of names as attendees. The default is to All, but tapping on another name deselects All. We'd be happy to help further! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Down grading 5 stars I rated 5 years ago to 3 atars. We're gold subscribers- have been for 12 years. While we think it's the best app for our family, in the last 4 years there have been numerous glitches - things not syncing (e.g. meals not syncing with calendar) functionality not there (recipe search function still doesn't work right) and we're told "they're working on it" but it to little avail. I hope with the new owners more attention will be given to tech support.

Mostly happy. I do wish the app had the same menu planner as the desktop version. I can add things to the menu on my PC and they show up in a separate menu only calendar on the PC, but in the regular calendar with everything else on the app.

Cozi provides a great way to coordinate schedules,shopping lists,and periodic events among family members. The upgrade to the premium version is well worthwhile for the improved calendaring and notification capabilities.
Love this app! My favorite thing is that I can share this with anyone I want and they can make changes as well. It's a shared app.
Great to share calendar and grocery list with my spouse.
Upgraded to be able to access calendar view and it is useless. Can't click on details unless in list view. Absolute garbage app
reviews.reply: Hi, Sorry for your disappointment and we'll forward your feedback! The mobile month view is designed to give you a monthly overview. To access appts from the month view, double-tap to go to the 2x2 zoom. Tap on an appt to open it, use the + to create a new appt or scroll vertically or horizontally to view neighboring or upcoming dates. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Love being able to share the grocery list and click it off.
Great for planning, remembering Dr. Appointments. The grocery list is a must do for my darling bride and me. I really like how our phones both up date when either of us puts something in Cozy

Recent Issues. The app won't sync in real time. It takes a lot of refreshing and hours for it to work. This has been the routine recently. Super disappointing. Also wish it had a notification setting for adding more things to a list!
reviews.reply: Hi Sarah, We're sorry for these issues! Could you please delete/reinstall the app and sign in again to resolve any glitches? If problems continue, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us for more help. We'd also be glad to forward your request for list notifications. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Wife and i use for good cross platform calendar and lists sharing. I have android she is iEverything so we use this. Premium subscription required for a decent experience sorry to say. But worth the price since free version is handicapped.
Great scheduling, list and reminder app
Super helpful and love the grocery planner!
Amazing app with great features! Just wish it was easier to sync with my Google calendar so I didn't need to enter into both. Please make it possible to do on mobile without PC!
reviews.reply: Hi, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi! Re. Google cal integration, you could sign into your Cozi acct from your tablet at my.cozi.com to generate outbound iCals, and then sign into the web version of Google cal on your tablet to add your Cozi iCals. You could also share from Google to Cozi in this same way. For help: cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: We've been using Cozi as our shared family calendar and to-do list for over 10 years. We can't say enough good things about the app and it's developers.
Works great but has limited alarm setting on free version
So many helpful features! Now working on adding meals into our calendar. I had no idea recipes could be downloaded into the app with one click.

This app is amazing 5 stars in fact, but something is wrong recently. My husband amd I have been using this app for MANY years, sharing the calendar schedule and grocery lists. Recently, the starting times of all my events has disappeared!!! Only the end time shows up for event. I have tried recreating events, changing the start time, changing dates, adding multiple days of the same event. Nothing makes the start time show up. What happened to the app? (Android and Apple devices)

Combines various lists and shared calendars in an easy to use platform. My wife and I really enjoy using it, with one huge caveat: once a grocery list is created, there is no option to alphabetize everything in the list or to move all checked items to the bottom. You can drag things, sure, but people have been asking for these features for NINE YEARS (Google "cozi sort", first result). I have nearly 10 minutes of JS experience under my belt and even I know how to sort lists. It's trivial.
This app is a great reminder when you are shopping. I make less trips to the store now and keep track of upcoming events.
It is very good a keeps the family aware the articles to buy, no matter who goes to the stores. I would love a barcode scanner to be included.
Finally my so and I can look at ONE calendar and coordinate our separate and together appointments without hiccups.
Reminders are not showing up till AFTER the event. Something is wrong.
reviews.reply: Hi Karen, Our support team would be happy to help you! Please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us, and in your message please confirm your time zone, the type of delivery that's affected (device notifications or emails), and the names of the people in your account who are affected. We'll be glad to resolve this for you! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Love! Connects to Google calendar so I can get my daily agenda on Alexa. Includes meal planning tool and recipes for easy grocery lists and reminders for birthdays! Love, Love, LOVE!
Our busy family of 5 stays connected and on track only because of Cozi! Once I finally made the leap from my paper calendar, I knew I'd never go back. Cozi is so convenient!

Ugh! I've used this app for years and loved it up until a few months ago when it suddenly stopped sending me reminders. The whole purpose of this, for me, was to remind myself of birthdays, events, etc. Once I became aware of not receiving reminders, I began to set "test" events. I'd set a reminder, then check it, and it would be gone. I'd set it again and get the same result. Very frustrating! Time for a new app... :(
reviews.reply: Hi Tricia, We're sorry for this issue, and our support team would be happy to help you to resolve it! Please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: So far, so good. Updates and reminders is great. The only tweet I would add is to identify who adds items to the grocery list. For example, if someone adds shampoo, I need to know who that is to get the right shampoo. Otherwise, great app.
AwesomenFamiky Calendar and Organizer!!
5 years if use by a family of 4. No complaints. Manages our shared calendar and shopping lists.
Something has gone wrong today. Cozi won't open and I have a message repeating "cozi keeps stopping" 'Sup?
reviews.reply: Hi Brady, We apologize again for this Android error, and we hope the instructions we sent from customer support yesterday resolved this issue. If not, we've replied again today with additional info that could be useful. Please check those messages and reply back to Cozi support if you need more help. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: App works well for organizing my large and extended family. One complaint is that it doesn't tell you who created a calendar entry.
reviews.reply: Hi Robert, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi, and we'd be glad to forward your request for an auditing feature to let you know who in your account made changes to the calendar and when. For any other help, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: ✍ I've been using Cozi regularly since 2013 & absolutely love it. I found it through flylady[.]net & it's helped me keep track of birthdays, anniversaries, multiple kid's schedules, a PLETHORA of recipes & my master grocery lists, all without fail❗ ➡️ I started w/ the free version & purchased gold which allowed me to input birthdays (w/ a selection of advanced reminders) & to my surprise, it all remained afte downgrading to the free version once again. ✔ it out, you won't be disappointed 😉
I like being able to make a grocery list on my cellphone and cross things off as I get them. Works great for me, super convenient.
After three or four days into the free trial, I went straight in for the upgrade. Family are on board and all using calendar, lists etc. Fab, easy-to-use organiser.

Generally a decent app. As a family we use this app daily and pay for the yearly membership. I work shifts so feel as though you should be able to add a rota so that you don't have to add all individual shifts to each individual day. I currently switch between a proper shift calendar (Supershift) and Cozi. I'd like to be able to relay on Cozi without having to cross reference against another calendar. I've never used the meal planner option since having the app and doubt I ever will.
reviews.reply: Hi, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi, and we appreciate your feedback! To advance to a future date, the best approach is via the drop-down mini-month cal. To use that tool, please tap on the down arrow next to the month title on the calendar screen. You could use this tool for reference or to advance to a future date to add an appt. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: The app jumps around. When you try to scroll down, it jumps back up. Takes several tries to get to later calendar entries, which is SUPER annoying. Otherwise, it keeps everybody organized. Love the lists.
Very useful app. Using this allows all family members remember about each other appointments or meetings. Well done x
I like the app. The only feature I have an issue with with the gold membership is the grocery list doesn't rearrange itself as advertised when you check something off.
Lack of notifications
reviews.reply: Hi, If you have reminders set up and device notifications from Cozi are authorized on your phone but you're not receiving them, that could occur if Android settings are suppressing these notifications. For example, please turn off battery-saving mode and sleep mode, and turn on auto start for Cozi. For more help: cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I would like it to go to the calendar screen utomatically
It's really frustrating that reminders aren't turned on by default. I've missed things because I accidentally forgot to turn them on. I'm actually close to switching apps because of that issue.
reviews.reply: Hi Anne, We're sorry that reminders aren't turned on by default, and we've forwarded your request for future consideration. We hope you'll decide to continue with Cozi, despite this limitation! If we can help with anything else, please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: We used to love this app but now it doesn't share with all family members and we can't figure out why not. The shopping list and calendar won't go to hubby

What did you do to the web app?!? We've used Cozi for MANY years. I use the monthly view at least 2x per month to pay bills, logged in today, and it is unrecognizable, ugly, and has added multiple mouse clicks - to change whose calendar I want to see, to change the month, to update a scheduled event. This is really awful.
reviews.reply: Hi Makon, We're sorry for your disappointment, and we've forwarded your feedback to our product team. It's possible that we could make additional changes in the future to address your concerns. For any other help, please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Recent updates have made the app much less user friendly. Used to be very easy to use on both browser and phones. Now you cannot access day 24 onwards in month view of calendar on laptops (safari and chrome) and the style of layout has changed making it harder to read and you cannot scroll down the calendar on non mobile devices
reviews.reply: Hi, We're sorry for any issues you're encountering, and we've forwarded your feedback to our product team. Our apologies for this inconvenience! Thanks, Cozi (help@cozi.com)

reviews.review: Been great to share calendar with family members
The best family calendar there is!
I love how the app works. It is easy to put in info. The reminders are great.

Been using Cozi for a few years now and it's most definitely my favourite family organiser by far. But I wondering if there was any chance of a PC version being released in the near future. I know it's very simple app to use on a phone or tablet but I was hoping for a PC version. I've been recently using my PC more than usual and find myself going back to my phone to add events, dinners, personal reminders etc.... Would this be possible or something already available that intergrates with Cozi?
reviews.reply: Hi Shannon, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi! If you have any trouble with this, or if we can help with anything else, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Great app but our calendar completely disappeared and logged us out about a month in, extremely disappointing.
reviews.reply: Hi Bella, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi, but we're sorry for any recent issues! Please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us so we can help. The only known reason for you to become logged out is if someone in the acct reset the password, but our support team will be able to investigate for you and resolve any problems. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I like being able to put an entry into one calendar and it syncs up to my childrens and husband calendar on their phones
This synchronized Appointment Calendar for the entire family's phones is such a great asset! No more wondering who has what Appointment where & with whom! We would be lost without it!

Way too many ads that are in your face. Also no option to see a month view unless you get the paid version. And $30 a year for ad-free is too much when this is exactly like Google Calendar. The only thing it has over Google Calendar is it does have a grocery list option. But not worth combating the ads everywhere for that feature.
reviews.reply: Hi, The free version of Cozi is supported by ads, but we're sorry if they feel intrusive to you. The full mobile month view is part of Cozi Gold, but you could access another month view from the free version by tapping on the month title above the calendar screen. For any other help, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I downloaded the program fine, then had issues trying to download my schedule from Google calendar and had to hand type it all in. All to find out my husband can't download the app on his phone which is the same model and on the same network as mine. I'm not happy.
reviews.reply: Hi Suzanne, Please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us so we can help to resolve these issues! We apologize for any problems you've encountered, and we'll be happy to help! Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Edited review. I've had some frustrations with the Cozi app for both android (mine) and iPhone (wife). I like the webpage, and I think that I will continue to used the webpage for grocery lists and calendar usage. I think my prior review might have been unnecessarily harsh as it was right after multiple issues with the app. I would use Cozi more frequently if there was a better mobile website, sized properly and with the features of the desktop website. I really don't understand why so often there are frustrating app versions of perfectly good websites.
reviews.reply: Hi Aaron, We're sorry for any difficulty you experienced with the Cozi app! If we can help to troubleshoot any problems, please reach our support team at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I've been using Cozi for years! It really helps my husband and I make plans for ourselves and the family. It has been a great/way to stay organized. From shared calendars to grocery and to-do lists. The kids are old enough now to put their own activities in the calendar so we know where everyone is.
My wife and I use this app daily and it is truly our favorite scheduling app of all
I love having a shared calendar it is great only down fall is it does not work with other app to up load appointments.
reviews.reply: Hi Lance, We're glad you're enjoying Cozi! It's possible to integrate some other types of internet calendars with Cozi, and here's a page with instructions: https://www.cozi.com/using-cozi-with-other-calendars/. If we can help further with this or anything else, please reach us at cozi.com/contact-us. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: I like that my family can share our schedules. Love the daily reminders. Hate the layout, what calendar has the date at the bottom of the box? Get's confusing to read.
Best digital calendar for keeping the family organized.
Very helpful with keeping my busy schedule organized. I wish it had a month calendar widget or at least make the current calendar widget scrollable.
reviews.reply: Hi Tera, Thanks for your feedback. We're sorry for any trouble you're experiencing with calendar sharing, and we'd be glad to help. Please send us a message at cozi.com/contact-us with information about what's occurring, and we'll do our best to assist you. Thanks, Cozi

reviews.review: Sometimes takes awhile to load calendar events.
I'd love a visual update. I like the UX of the calendar just not the UI. I think you could modernise it without taking away from the core experience.

description:
GTasks is a simple and efficient todo / task management app with Google synchronization. You can customize your to do list, set reminder, send tasks to your friends, family members or colleagues and sync with your Google Tasks perfectly. With it, you will never miss a task and focus on what really matters to boost productivity. 

Latest Update:

** New Material Design update to adapt to Android L (5.0) 
** Import tasks from Astrid 


** Widget doesn't work if GTasks was installed on SD card. Please move it back to phone internal storage and reboot your device. 

Features:
1. ICS(Android 4.0) style with bulk indent/move/set due date/delete and so on
2. View your tasks on Google Calendar
3. Synchronize with multiple Google accounts automatically; also support local mode
4. Customize sync mode: auto sync, manual sync or sync when open/exit/background sync
5. Batch add tasks 
6. Scroll horizontally to switch between tasks/task lists
7. Sort your tasks by due date/name/create time/priority
8. Re-arrange your tasks easily by dragging & dropping
9. Indent to create subtasks
10. Send tasks to friends, families and colleagues 
11. Set customized repeating reminders: daily/weekly/monthly... and so on
12. Quick add tasks by pressing the search key
13. Quick add tasks via ‘note to self’ voice command with Google Now 
14. Quick search tasks 
15. Create different home screen Widgets (scrolling in LauncherPro/ADWLauncher/GO Launcher)
We are asking for permissions to access Contacts, Phone status, Microphone & Calendar on your phone in order to offer related features.

description:
Habit Hunter (Originally Goal Hunter) is a free app that helps you build a habit of creating and managing your goal logically and effectively. Set personal goals, break down goals into tasks (or to-do list), track your progress, and motivate yourself to achieve new heights!

What can you do with the Habit Hunter app? 
Habit Hunter uses a special technique, called Gamification, which will turn your goal, habit, and task to an RPG game. In the game, you'll become a hero finding ways to win monsters and save people. The more task you complete in your real life, the stronger the hero will be.

 
Furthermore, Habit hunter lets you:

description:
Focus To-Do combines Pomodoro Timer with Task Management, it is a science-based app that will motivate you to stay focused and get things done.

Focus To-Do syncs between your phone and computer, so you can access your lists from anywhere.

       3. When the pomodoro timer rings, take a 5 minute break.
 
Key Features:

- ⏱ Pomodoro Timer：Stay focused and get more things done.

description:
Productive is a free and easy-to-use habit tracker that helps you build a routine of positive, life changing habits. Set personal goals, track your progress, and motivate yourself to achieve new heights!

Productive habit tracker is here to help you make the most of your task management and get things done. Whether you want to break bad, arrange a good habits list, or set task reminder, our app will guide and motivate you on a daily basis. Achieve your goals with our task tracker!

What can you do with the Productive habit tracker?

★ Plan your habits and tasks with an easy-to-use interface
★ Schedule tasks for any time of the day
★ Set smart reminders for your habit list for each time of the day
★ Stay on track with useful statistics

Why should you download the Productive habit tracker?

SIMPLICITY:
The clear and beautiful interface that will help you build customised habits lists, based on our handy habit presets. 

CUSTOMIZATION:
The app is fully customizable - you can name your habit, choose a unique icon and even pick its color. It is easy to create a task list that is perfect for you.

STATISTICS:
Track your habits and analyze progress for a task - build motivating chains when completing them. The longer your chain of completed tasks, the more likely you will keep the streak going.

NOTIFICATIONS
Smart reminders give a summary of what tasks from your list are scheduled for each part of the day.

TIME MANAGEMENT 
Habits and tasks broken down into daily fragments of your routine and suitable for anyone who wants to achieve more in less time.

PREMIUM FEATURES
Subscribe to Premium for even more great features to boost your personal productivity: 
- Unlimited number of habits
- Improved reminders for your task and habit lists
- Motivating stats for each habit

There are many things you may want to improve. Productive will help you track your habits, like taking your pills regularly, exercising, or keeping to a diet. It can also be used by people who have difficulty focusing and concentrating, allowing them to create their own daily tasks and habits to work on.

description: Achieve more by improving your productivity with the Boosted - Productivity & Time Tracker app. Understand your habits with insightful reports and improve your productivity and time management with various productivity tools like the Pomodoro timer and simple time tracking. By tracking your time, you'll be able to understand your current habits and you'll be able to use this knowledge to build better ones. Time tracking should be as effortless as possible To spend the day effectively, you need to invest your time wisely. By using the productivity and time management tools in Boosted, you can make better use of your time. description:
Onelap GPS Security System is a combination of Device and Mobile App with following features. 
1. Live Tracking : Real time location and Address 

2. Engine Access : Switch on or switch off vehicle using your mobile, from anywhere. A great feature for theft and related emergencies. 

3. History Video: Watch full day history video to see where your vehicle went in just 20 seconds. You can select any date. See the address and time of existence of vehicle at every place it visited. 

4. Safe-Zone or Geo-fence: Mark office, home or any place as safe-zone to get push notification on vehicle entry and exit from safe-zone. This features keeps you updated for all entries and exist with timestamp. 

5. Daily Stats: Get Total Distance, Run Time, Idle Time, Stoppage Time, Maximum Speed and Average Speed for everyday travel of your vehicle. 

6. Analytics of Daily stats: Compare daily performance on graphs with previous data points and average score.
 
7. Compatibility: Compatible with Car, Bus, Truck and Bikes. 

8. Access or Login: Multiple vehicles can be tracked on a single mobile dashboard. Onelap GPS Security system can be installed at any hidden portion of the vehicle. One can track all his/her vehicles on single mobile dashboard.
summary: Track vehicle, Lock Engine, Driving history, Analytics, Set Geofence & much more

description: This app provides different plank variations to help you lose weight, gain strength and get a stronger core. The mixing of static and dynamic planks really helps you burn fat fast. Planks are the most popular and effective fat burning exercise. They can be easily performed and activate all your muscles, including your core, shoulders, glutes, etc. Planks are the best choice for people with weak knees because they put no pressure on knees. Maximize the belly fat burning: Planks are more effective than crunches at burning belly fat. Planks activate 100% of your abs, while crunches only involve 64% of them. Strengthen your core: Plank workout fires up all your core muscle groups, enhances your core strength, and helps you get a strong core. Reduce back pain: Plank workout can strengthen your back muscles, reduce back pain and lower the risk of back and spinal column injuries. Improve your posture & balance: Plank workout requires your head, back and feet to be in a straight line. Regularly doing this will improve your balance and posture when sitting and standing. Accelerate your metabolism: Doing planks keeps your metabolism high for the whole day; this dramatically boosts the fat burning process. Improve your flexibility: Plank workout stretches all your posterior muscle groups, such as your shoulder blades, glutes and hamstrings, thus improving your flexibility and lowering the risk of injury. description: “Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.” - Jim Ryun. "The HabitHub" is a powerful app that can be used to track habits, accomplish your goals and finally rewire yourself. • Streaks HabitHub is based on Seinfeld's productivity secret, which involves building long streaks of days. These streaks that you build will motivate you to keep moving forward. • Themes HabitHub comes with four beautiful prebuilt themes. • Calendars HabitHub comes with a full-featured calendar view for every habit to track and visualize your chains. • Reminders Do you keep on forgetting that habit of yours? No worries !! HabitHub comes with a powerful reminder system that will help you stay on top of all your habits. • Ready for Smartwatches HabitHub sends out the reminders directly to your smartwatch allowing you to mark the days directly from the watch. • Notes Want to keep a journal? How about keeping track of your daily achievements !! With HabitHub you can add notes to any day you want and even read all the notes sorted by the last week, month or even year !! • Flexible goals Do you want flexibility in your habits? Do you want to go jogging just on the weekends or hit the gym 4 times every week? HabitHub comes with a very sophisticated scheduling system that can track any habit you can imagine. • Category HabitHub comes with the ability to categorize habits according to various aspects of your life to keep you sane and focused !! • Widgets Track your habits and goals right from the home screen with SIX beautiful widgets for FREE !! • Graphs Want to know how you have been doing with those goals/habits? See the big picture with the help of graphs. Gain insights into what's working for you and what's not working. Get a break down of all the successful and failed days by weeks, months or years. • Backup Automatically backup your data to external storage providers. • Import Already using other apps ? Import your tracking data from apps like habits streak with just a click. How it works ? 1. Setup your habit 2. Mark the days on calendar every time you perform the habit. 3. Soon you will build a chain. 4. Don't Break the chain !! Your life is essentially the sum of your habits. What you repeatedly do is ultimately the person you become. Big goals are never reached by big leaps, but by many small steps. HabitHub help's you in taking these small steps and ultimately reaching these goals. To help you reach these goals HabitHub lets you set daily reminders and even provides with graphs that help you stay motivated along your journey. On top of this every morning when you wake up, HabitHub sends you nice little motivational quote :) With HabitHub your task is to build a long streak of days for the habit you are working. The longer your streak, the better it is !! It will take a couple of months to build a solid habit, but don't give up, stay at it !! Be consistent and it will work.
summary: HabitHub - Everything you need to reach your goals and build lasting habits !!

Out of all habit tracker apps this app is the simplest and has the best functionality. However, the app looks abit dated. I hope the developers update it soon.
The notifications don't work, which defeats the purpose of the app.

Looked good on paper but first habit I attempted to input soon had me realising its limitations. If I wanted to set a reminder throughout the day have to upgrade to premium. Not paying for something without first checking out if fit for purpose.
One of my favorite app. Good and simple interface. 6 years passed since my firts review, I paused usage for quite a while, bun now I'm back. I enjoy the plesant interface, I enjoy quotes. Thanks!
The best habit tracker ever!
Good basic habit tracker but found something better suited

The app is certainly the best habit tracker. But it needs more themes, like Nord Theme. Another suggestion is that the rewards are registered by habits, each habit with a separate reward. The widget doesn't work since last update.

Is there an iOS version? Love it 🙂! I tried out tons of habit apps but this was the best. The more affordable one-time fee was a big reason, but it also met all my needs and I like using it. Categories are a must. I haven't used the rewards part yet, but that is an extra many other apps don't have. I also love that it has dark mode, I can disable all notifications, and it doesn't make sounds.

I like the calendar widget that I can quickly look at to see in a broad sense how I'm sticking to a habit, without feeling bad about missing a day here and there and spiraling. I also like the graphs so I can see which habits I need to be careful that are slipping away/feeling motivated about strengthening. Love it, Premium is totally worth it for me.

Love it. It has the best widget's of any habit tracker. The app could be more beautiful, but that doesnt effect functionality. This is one of few apps I have paid for premium.

description:
Weather forecast app let you know weather information exactly.

Weather forecast is very important for life. With a reliable weather channel, You will have weather information to prepare your plan.
What is the weather today? Weather forecast app give you right answer. Weather today will be updated hourly. Weather forecast app also has a weather report on weather tomorrow, weather for today, also 10 day weather forecast
With weather forecast you can see weather of your location and also you can know weather of many places on the world. If you are in New York, You can see London weather, Paris weather, San Francisco weather, Houston weather...

Weather app is very easy to use. Please open app, enable location then you receive the weather forecasts in your current location.
Then weather report provides current weather forecast, weather observation for all world locations, Weather forecast searches for your address automatically, you can choose temperature unit is Celsius or Fahrenheit.
There are many information in weather forcasts which includes atmospheric pressure, weather condition, visibility distance, relative humidity, precipitation in different unites, dew point, wind speed and direction, in addition to ten days future forecast, also hourly weather forecast.
Realtime temperature, humidity, pressure, wind force and wind direction are all in this weather app based.

Weather app has a lot of features:
- Free. It is a free Weather channel, weather network.
- Global. You can see weather in any places you like, ex: London weather, Paris weather, San Francisco weather, Houston weather
- Full report. Displays all information of weather: location time, temperature, atmospheric pressure, weather condition, visibility distance, relative humidity, precipitation in different unites, dew point, wind speed and direction
- Live weather forecast for free: this weather and climate app offers daily weather, hourly weather forecasts and monthly weather forecasts. Meanwhile, it also provides interstate travel weather forecasts and forecast weather and wind.
- Today, tomorrow, 3 days later, 7 days later. Weather for today, tomorrow’s weather, … hourly weather in each hour.
- Automatic location detection by network or GPS.
- Add and track the weather reports in multiple locations
- Weather notifications. Show you warnings and alerts updates, if you don't like you can make it invisible
- If you are living in big city like New York, London, Paris you don’t need to enable GPS, the app can detect right location over network then give exactly info such cities.


please download weather forecast app, if you have any suggestion please let me know.
summary: weather channel with reliable daily forecasts, weather report

description: Just Run is a simple workout app to help you get running. I made this app to get myself off the couch and start running to get to 5K. Stick to the workout plan, and you'll be able to run 5K in 9 weeks. It really does work! If you're already able to run 5K, Just Run also has a 6-week plan to help you get up to 10K! Workout Plans - Zero to 5K: Gets you from absolute zero running experience to 5K in just 9 weeks, with three 30-minute workouts per week - 5K to 10K: If you can already run 5K, or have finished Zero to 5K, this plan gets you to 10K in only 6 weeks Features 📅 Target dates for each workout, calculated based on your progress, and optimal exercise days 📣 Choose from multiple trainer voices, which tell you exactly when to run and walk 📱 Lock screen notification so you don't need to unlock your phone to check your progress 🚫 No ads! Ads are no fun, so Just Run has no ads! 🎵 Works with music, audiobook and podcast apps - Just Run will briefly lower the volume of the other app when prompting you to run and walk, so you'll never miss a prompt 🔽 Tiny download (less than 3MB), so Just Run will take up very little space on your device ➕ Upgrade to Premium to get more trainer voices, multiple theme options, and to support continued development of Just Run I'd love to hear how you're getting on with Just Run. You can email me at run@jupli.com. --- Just Run is the successor to Syncostyle's 5K Trainer and B210K Trainer. If you liked those, Just Run will feel very familiar!
summary: A super simple running app with a 9-week Zero to 5K plan!
changelog:
🔊 Two new Premium trainer voices to choose from, 🇦🇺 Charlotte and 🇨🇦 Owen. They replace Sophie and Dan, with higher quality recordings. I've really enjoyed testing these new trainers while going running, I hope you like them too!
🔒 Fixed a bug with the screen lock button

reviews.review: Love it! Easy to use, own music, lightweight, intuitive. I do wish there was an option to add in a sprint for the last 10-20 seconds of each running interval to make it a bit more HIIT, and to get me used to sprinting. But it's still great!
Nice, simple minimal app, no ads, can listen to music whilst getting prompts and no unnecessary notifications. Perfect to get your running mojo back!

I enjoyed the app, but I feel like it should be called "0 to 30". I tried this out as an intermediate runner, to use as a motivational tool. Without tracking pace, there is no guarantee that 30 minutes equals a 5k. It's a little misleading to beginners. Most of the integers are good, but there's a jump from 8 to 20 minutes in one week, then another from 10 to 22 another week, which again seems unrealistic for a beginner. I do really like the reminder to warm up and cool down, steps I often skip.

Simpel, effective (even for someone who previously hated running) and good customer support. I bought premium and eventhough that's just 4 voices and 4 tilecolours I'd still say it's worth it, cause it's so well made and stores no data like most others do. You even get a two in one, cause the 5 to 10k app is included through settings and switching has no effect on the stored progress. Works very well with Spotify on in the background and intergrated screenlock is a blessing.

I've tried many other 5K running programmes (paid and free) and this is by far the best - the programme is well-structured to gradually build your stamina, interface is clean and simple, and it's free! I would gladly subscribe for a paid version that includes a GPS tracking function :) well done

This was very basic but super easy to use. Loved the interval times to start, moving to longer distances was less daunting than expected. Appreciated the halfway turnaround reminder. The simplicity is probably why I stuck with the whole program, which is unusual for me. Thanks to this, I restarted my running habit.

I have only one run left before I finish the C25k program but I figured I'd give my rating now. This is one of the best apps I've downloaded! It's made the program so much easier and enjoyable. It's lightweight, yet has the "bells and whistles" that I need like: timer in the notification section and lowering volume of other apps so the "run, walk, halfway" dialogues can be heard. It also doesn't drain my battery or bombard with ads. Thanks!!

A perfect app. Just Run does exactly what I want it to and nothing more. That includes no price tag, no invasive GPS tracking, no ads, no collecting data to sell, no social media gamification... In these days when every breath and blink is tracked and sold, Just Run is a minor miracle. Download this immediately and start taking better care of yourself, without being weighed down by ads and privacy invasions.

Got to be the best couch-to-5k (and then option up to 10k) app out there. It's small, no ads, very straightforward presentation, easy to use, doesn't need with whatever music/podcast playback you have going. Only monetization is an optional donation page. Stellar app.
very good, my favorite part is the lady at the end of your run saying nice things.

My favourite running app, NO ADS!! I LOVE that Jupli made a running app that does not contain ads. You can get premium which supports the developer & gets you some different colours and voices, or just stick to the basics! I never leave reviews on apps, but I've used this app multiple times to get back into running and it works every time. You have to put in the work (obviously), but it takes care of the rest. I have recommended this app to SO many of my friends. Thank you Jupli <3

Very simple to use app, which is exactly what I wanted. It has no gps function, which let's me use my own without conflict. I love how it updates my schedule if I miss a date, so I can see my new end dates automatically. The ease of use and non-pushiness of premium/lack of ads was definitely a major component to me purchasing the "premium" version. 100% would recommend this app. Thanks for relying on quality content for revenue, instead of spamming me like most others!

This is a good training app. I'm a horrible jogger/runner and wanted something to help me with a 3K. This app helps you become better. I was able to hang until week 5. In week 5, there was a drastic jump from day 2 (8 min running) to day 3 (20 min running). So I was definitely struggling lol. But I just pause the timer for a bit to catch my breath.

I really enjoy this app. It's simple to use , doesn't take up too much resources, doesn't require any crazy permissions. It does a good job announcing when you've completed half of your run and when to start cooling down. One thing that might make it slightly better, if there were a way to announce during your run how much time you have completed, like every 15 minutes or so. Overall a great running app!

A really simple, no-frills, running app. The plan starts off extremely doable so even if you haven't run in years and get tuckered just jogging down the street, you'll be able to handle it. No ads, doesn't constantly pester you with notifications, just guides you on a run when you turn it on and nothing more. It doesn't lock any features behind a paywall either, just additional trainer voices and colour schemes if you want to support the developer. Perfect little app! Gladly supported the dev.
The best running app for beginners. Super simple and straight forward. What are you waiting for? Go out and run.

I'm new to running, and wanted an app to give me a program to stick to for motivation. I've only done the first run, but I'm really impressed with the app so far. It works exactly as it should, looks nice, and is completely free. I'm so impressed that I might have to tip the dev a few bucks for their great work. If you want to get into running but don't know where to start, I can't think of a better app to download!

I had run 5k years ago but then stopped, it wa hard not to over do myself trying to get back to it and this app saved me, premium is not necessary but the app is so good I wanted to support them, this is my last week of 5k running and I enjoyed it so much I am going for the 10k training next week, if you want to run weather done before or not this is certainly the best app there is for it
Free version is great. Sound ducking works well over Spotify and calls, visualisation of run/walk time is nice.
Simply the best app to learn running
The workouts are fantastic and the tool is simple and effective. Can't praise it enough. If you're looking to get into running, this is the app for you

I'm using this app to begin my running training and I'm loving it, every day I see the running/walking layout and I think I'm going to have a really hard time, especially on Monday's when it's a new week. But I surprise myself everytime. This app has been perfect for me so far. I will admit I did struggle in the beginning and had to walk a bit of the last part. I've just completed week 3 and can successfully complete the entire workout. I'm 140 kgs, do with that info what you will :) great app!!

Love this app. I've tried several when I started trying to run, but it never worked. Due to injuries I can't run 3 times per week as the app suggests, but the app doesn't judge me for just doing it twice (other apps give you annoying notifications when skipping a day). Also the advice to just move and later focus on speed helped me so much. The voice gives you just enough inform without being annoying, so you can listen to music the rest of the run. Amazing app

Been using this app for three weeks now and am impressed so far. It's simple and to the point, laying out which days to run, the intervals for each day, and even includes tips/encouragement for workouts. I don't have to take my phone out of my pocket to mess with the app once the timer is started. There's even a useful feature that tells me when I'm halfway done and can head back on my route. I don't plan to run a 5k, but this app makes doing some cardio more obtainable in general.

This is the perfect app for minimalist run training. No fluff. Just your timer, your "daily" tracker, and a boice telling you when to do what. Absolutely worth it. I throw spotify on in the background and get through it.

I've tried several different running apps over the years and none of them compare to this one. The fade in/out of my own music for instructions is perfect, I love the minimalist UI, and the premium features aren't necessary for function (but it's only $2.50, well worth it just to support this awesome app). Fingers crossed I'll actually stick to running now!

description:
Experience video conferencing in the most effortless and effective way possible. 

Lifesize delivers award-winning, cloud-based video conferencing technology that allows you to connect, communicate, and collaborate—from one-on-one audio and video calls to full-scale company meetings spanning multiple locations.

With the Lifesize app, you can stay connected on the go. Start or join a meeting instantly, meet face to face with the highest-quality video and audio, share your screen, chat in real time, sync with your calendar, and more.

Lifesize. Work together.

Features include:
•	Start a call or schedule a meeting instantly
•	Share content from your device with other participants while in a call
•	Comprehensive, name-based directory with search and status

•	Swipe to hide video and enter listen-only mode
•	Pinch to zoom in on video and presentations

•	Control room system camera from your device in supported calling situations
•	Optionally enable dark mode to switch to a darker color scheme

Have a question or need help? Contact us at https://www.lifesize.com/support

description:
Organize your thoughts, discoveries, and ideas and simplify planning important moments in your life with your digital notepad. Take notes on your phone and sync them across all your devices with Microsoft OneNote.

With OneNote, you can plan a big event, seize a moment of inspiration to create something new, and track your list of errands that are too important to forget. Take notes, write memos and make a digital sketchbook right on your phone. Capture pictures and add images to your notes.

Sync notes across your devices to access them anytime, anywhere. Save ideas and check your list at home, in the office, or on the go across your devices. Search your notes quickly and effortlessly.

Take notes, share ideas, organize and collaborate with Microsoft OneNote today.

Homepage & Quick Capture Bar
• Find all notes from your connected accounts in one place to easily create, find, & act on your notes
• Now with Samsung Notes integration
• Capture text, voice, ink or images to your notepad with Quick Capture
• Capture notes in ink. Click the pen button & write down your thoughts

Scan Pictures & Extract Text
• Notes Scanner: Scan documents, pictures, or files to extract notes
• Capture images to extract text from documents, files, & more
• Apply different filters to change colors, add ink, crop images & more

Audio Notes
• Take accurate voice notes with voice dictation
• Click the Mic button to begin recording, then click it again to end recording & save the file
• Dictate notes in 27 languages (note some languages are in preview) & use Auto-Punctutation to automatically format your notes

Capture Content & Get Organized
• Write notes, draw & clip things from the web to add to your notebook
• Use OneNote’s flexible canvas to place content anywhere you want

Take Notes & Achieve More
• Organize your notes using to-do lists, follow up items, marks for what’s important & custom labels
• Use OneNote as a notebook, journal or a notepad

Save Ideas At The Speed of Light
• OneNote syncs your notes across all devices & lets multiple people work on the content together, at the same time
• Notepad badge hovers on screen & lets you quickly write your thoughts down any time
• Sticky notes are helpful for quick memos

Collaborate & Share Notes
• Take meeting notes, brainstorm projects, & draw attention to important points
• Take notes & save ideas across your favorite devices, no matter what device your team likes to use
• Search your notes with a fast & powerful search function

Better Together With Microsoft Office
• OneNote is part of the Office family & works great with your favorite apps, such as Excel or Word, to help you do more

Write notes, save ideas & keep up with your to-do list with Microsoft OneNote.

You can find answers to frequently asked questions about OneNote for Android at http://aka.ms/OnenoteAndroidFAQ

Requirements:
• Requires Android OS 5.0 or later.
• A free Microsoft account is required to use OneNote.
• OneNote opens existing notebooks created in Microsoft OneNote 2010 format or later.
• To sync your notes to OneDrive for Business, sign in with your organization’s Office 365 or SharePoint account.

This app is provided either by Microsoft or a third-party app publisher and is subject to a separate privacy statement and terms and conditions. Data provided through the use of this store and this app may be accessible to Microsoft or the third-party app publisher, as applicable, and transferred to, stored and processed in the United States or any other country where Microsoft or the app publisher and their affiliates or service providers maintain facilities.

Please refer to Microsoft’s End User License Agreement (EULA) for Terms of Service for OneNote on Android. By installing the app, you agree to these terms and conditions: https://support.office.com/legal?llcc=en-us&aid=OneNoteForAndroidLicenseTerms.htm. Microsoft’s privacy statement is available at https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

description: Declutter your mind Repeat lets you focus on the routines you will have to do today. Combining both Goal tracker and habit tracker. Repeat will show your pending habit on a given day and will only just focus on that given day. With that approach you can focus more on the task at hand. No more pressure to do the things that you have to do. Make yourself a better you Do you try and formed a new habit but still slipping back to old bad habit? Repeat not only shows you the task you will have to do, it will also show why you do what you do and the consequences should you fail to do it. It gives you that choice between the pain of discipline or the pain of failure. Simple yet elegant Repeat comes with night and day color scheme that is relaxing to the eye. Start with small It takes 70 days to form a habit, Repeat will remind you and will notify you if you have a pending habit on a given time. Voice assistant Tired of reading notification messages? Repeat comes with a voice assistant that will read your pending habit on a given time. Empower you Repeat will show you motto from famous and successfull people(Jim Rohn, Les Brown, Tony robins) to help you push through the tough times to get you to where you want to be. Simplicity Repeat is a simple app that focuses on the core functionality of a habit and goal tracker app. It's like writing your goals on a paper. FREE and no forceful Ads Repeat is free. The ads won't be force to you instead, it is an option if you want to enable the ads as a support. How it works? 1. Take a moment to decide what goal do you want. Always remember the S.M.A.R.T goal. 2. Mark the habit depending whether you do it or failed to do it 3. Don't break the chain. Keep pushing through. You are what you were when. If you want to change your life you have to start having some goals. If you want to achieve those goals, you have to get rid of the bad habits and form a new one. Big goals are achieve by setting small goals. Achieving small goals leads to big achievement that will turn out to be your big goal. Repeat will help you to take these small steps towards your goal. Keep pushing through. Repeat the task over and over until it became a habit. Once you have done that you now have achieve your goal. Don't break the chain be consistent and soon all your bad habits will be gone. Always remember "Success is something you attract by becoming a better you, not something you pursue"

description:
The 100% free “In Love while Parenting” App grants you access to cutting-edge research and tips that will help you build a strong, loving relationship with your partner while you raise happy, well-adjusted children. Years of ground-breaking research and findings in Psychology, Neuroscience and Relationships have been curated into one easy-to-use app… for free (no in-app-purchases)!

No more need to spend precious time combing through countless articles, reading lists, or listening to unsolicited advice. Our daily lessons will help you manage relationship information overload by giving you science-based advice. These short, easy-to-understand lessons can be implemented immediately to improve your family life.

DID YOU KNOW
• 67% of users described the app as “life-changing”
• 78% of users reported better relationships with their partner and children
• 98% of users continue to use the concepts in their family

KEY FEATURES
• Customized, science-based app
• Short daily lessons that fit easily in your busy schedule
• Knowledge you can immediately put into practice
• Alerts and insights
• Years of scientifically-backed research and findings

In Love while Parenting has improved the lives of countless users- hit “INSTALL” now to see how it can change yours!


ABOUT US
The Human Improvement Project is a non-profit foundation dedicated to funding projects that discover what makes the largest positive impacts on families. We work with the nation’s leading psychologists, psychiatrists, relationship experts,  and neuroscientists to guide couples on the pathway to optimal relationships.
summary: A science-based app for couples with children from a non-profit foundation.

description: Moovit is one app for all your urban mobility rides 🚍🚇🚘🛴. 🏆 "If you need to get anywhere by mass transit, you need Moovit...it will open up a new world for you, even if you just travel domestically" - USA Today 🏆 Transportation is an integral part of urban living. Whether you ride the train🚆, subway🚇, bus🚍, light rail🚈, ferry⛴️ or metro, use dockless scooters🛴, bikes🚴‍♀️, ride-sharing like Uber🚘 or Lyft, getting the best urban mobility information is critical. Moovit provides riders with a one-stop-shop journey experience to help them get from point A to B in the easiest and most efficient way. Get train and bus times, maps, live navigation, and real-time arrival information with ease so you can plan your trip with confidence. Pay for your ride. Find critical alerts and service disruptions for your favorite lines. Get step-by-step directions of optimal route bus, train, metro, bike, scooter, or a combination of them. Moovit guides more than 930 million users in over 3400 cities throughout the world. Commuters will find updated bus times and train times, transit maps, and, where available, real-time line arrivals. Locate nearby bus stops and train stations, travel with on-the-go live navigation guidance, receive get-off alerts at your destination to ensure a smooth ride.. This is why Moovit has been named one of the best apps of the year in 2016 and 2017 by the Google Play and App Stores, respectively. 🚍 Real time arrivals. View real-time arrival updates, which are taken directly from GPS devices positioned on buses and trains. Avoid wasting time guessing train or bus times 💳 Digital payment. Purchase bus & train tickets and validate your digital pass with a tap using your mobility wallet (in supported metros) ⌚ Real time alerts. Know about issues ahead of time by receiving service alerts such as emergency or unexpected disruptions, delays, traffic jams, new construction, and more so that you can plan ahead if your bus time or train time changed 🔔 Live Navigation. Get step-by-step bus live directions and other transit directions with live guidance from A-to-B: Know how long you need to walk to your station, view the arrival time of your line, receive get-off alerts at your destination & more 🚏 Stops' visualization. Use augmented reality to locate your bus or train stop with "Way Finder" 📱User reports. Moovit’s users report issues found with stations, line service, and schedules so that we can inform all nearby riders about what’s going on in their area 🚩Favorite lines, stations, and places. Get easy access to lines, stations, and places you ride and visit all the time. Plus, get real-time updates if/when there are changes to your Favorite lines in case your bus time or train time is impacted! 🚴 Bike routes. Get bike routes in addition to the bus, subway, train, or metro trip plans. If you ride bikes (yours or shared) we can plan a route that includes the train or bus. Moovit will help you plan a trip that meets your transit-needs. Bike docking stations are updated in real-time. Bike trip plans are only available in supported metro areas 🗺️ Maps view. View all stations, routes, and lines on the subway or bus map. Additionally, maps are available in PDF for when you’re offline, or underground on the subway Moovit is the #1 urban mobility app in the world. We’re proud to collaborate with public transit agencies across the US, including: * MTA * NJ Transit * MBTA * LA Metro * SFMTA Muni * BART * Caltrain * CTA * Metra * WMATA * MTA Maryland * TriMet * Sound Transit * SARTA * PARTA & more You only need one app on your phone to navigate nearby buses and transit in the U.S. and across 112 other countries and in 45 languages! Contact us: https://moovitapp.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new moovit@Facebook, Twitter

description:
zenly is the social app that maps your world :)
build your very own map of the world, with the people and places that make it uniquely yours!! join the 10s of millions of people already using zenly to:

KNOW WHAT YOUR FRIENDS ARE UP TO
see their real-time location, if they’re at home, work, or school. see how fast they’re going if they’re on the move, or how long they’ve been pitched up at the coffee shop. check if their phone is running out of battery or if they’re charging up for the party tonight

SEE YOUR WORLD
zenly shows a live map of your world. see where your friends are, who’s hanging out, and keep tabs on all the places you go. share your real-time location with your people without draining battery. plus, go somewhere new and it will uncover on your map, like your own virtual scratch map

CREATE CHAOS IN YOUR CONVOS
bring chaos to your heartfelt 1:1s and your group chats. send voice notes with automatic transcription. say how you really feel with secret emoji combos and text-sizing. send a what’s up to a friend to see a photo or video of what they’re up to right now (ie vibe check the party before making tracks)

ADD YOUR PLACES
zenly automatically detects where you’re hanging, so you can add your places and personalize your map. climb the public leaderboard each time you visit a place. plus, tag friends that were there with you and get notified when the crew are hanging out somewhere cool. check out your friends’ highlights to see what they were up to over the past 24 hours

SHARE YOUR WORLD 
share your world on your public profile to show the world who you are based on where you spend your time IRL. check out other people’s worlds to see the places they hang out and the areas they’ve uncovered

FIND ANYTHING
delete your map app and search for people, places, and addresses on zenly instead. find out if your friend has been to that restaurant you’ve been meaning to try, if it’s a local fav, and if it’s suitable for big groups. no more anonymous reviews, just helpful info that can only be found on zenly :)

GET DIRECTIONS
zip it to your friend’s place or tonight’s date spot without having to search for directions. get walking, cycling and driving directions, call a car or find a scooter nearby, all without having to leave the app. plus, see public transit options, journey time, and train carriage info

AND BUUUUMMMMP
hanging with friends? shake your phone to experience the magic of bump, and celebrate being together :)

ZENLY LIKE A PRO
-> remember that your friend needs to accept your friend request before you can see each other’s live location on the map
-> need some time off the map? turn on ghost mode at any time
-> need some help? email love@zen.ly or contact the care team directly in app

got it?
time to zenly your world
summary: the app that maps your world

description:
Welcome Goal Achiever!

This Apps' mission is to encourage, support, and reward you for taking meaningful daily action towards the attainment of your goals, big or small. To help you take consistent action long after the excitement you felt when you committed to a worthy goal has faded.

One of the reasons you might not be successful at reaching a goal is because you did not take consistent and sustained action for a long enough period of time.

This checklist was especially created to help you take daily consistent action over time.

"For changes to be of any true value, they've got to be lasting and consistent." - Tony Robbins

"...we have to make good decisions, use discipline and be consistent for long enough to see the results we desire." - Darren Hardy


The idea is simple:
1. Enter the actions you know you have to take daily to reach a goal. Like: Workout for 40 minutes, make 10 cold calls to prospective customers, send out 10 resumes to potential employers, write at least 10 pages for project, etc.

2. Put the widget on your home screen. When an action is not yet completed it shows up in bright colored text. Once you check an action off the list the text becomes a lighter color.

3. Your daily mission now becomes to see the list go from bright (in the morning) to gray (before going to bed). You can instantly see how far down your action list you are at a glance. This color change also signals that you had a successful day. A day in which you accomplished all the actions you needed to take you one day closer to your ultimate goals.

A successful day, with all items checked, results in a green check mark placed on the calendar. Watching a series of check marks fill up the calendar, helps motivate you to stay consistent. 

There is an indicator on the main list screen that shows the number of consecutive successful days. This is your success streak. A streak with seven or more days turns this indicator green. This gives additional motivation for consistency.

The home screen widget also serves as a constant reminder of the actions you need to take today. Each time you use your Android device you'll see the list and the amount of actions remaining.

In short: Don't go to bed if your list is not completed. If bedtime is near and your list is not close to completion, get to work on what is left on the list!

Note: This version has a limit of 2 goals and an unlimited number of actions.

If you have any questions or comments send an email to:
checklist.help@gmail.com

Ideas for Uses:
- Goal achievement
- Motivation
- Build and re-enforce good habits
- Behavior modification
- Build discipline
- Daily to do list

Features:
- Simple visual design to remind you of your success actions
- Number of unchecked high priority items displayed at top of on screen widget
- Priority indicator to designate importance of items
- Priority significance chooser. Allows you to specify which priority level items need to be checked to gain a daily check mark
- A variety of text and background color choices
- Change text size of list and widget
- Alert on individual list items
- Automatic daily list reset at a time you specify. You dictate when your day ends
- Cloud Sync your List to other Android devices

Permissions:
- Contacts: Find accounts on the device – Needed to connect to Google Firebase for Cloud Sync
- Storage: Modify/Delete SD card contents - Backup and restore database to SD card
